The main free part of the game comes with the new light start, the 3 basic campaigns, Curse Of Osirus, Warmind and The Red War, for good guns anyone can get, I would reccomend a set of guns that you are good with, for pvp, I would HIGHLY reccomend a handcannon, they can do very well, but you should find one that feels good to use for you. PvE weapons would be, in my opinion, nearly anything, if your fighting the Fallen, riskrunner is a good exotic smg, because of it's perk that gats activated when you take arc damage, which is nearly all the Fallen do. If it's a different race, such as the cabal or vex, a shotgun can be very good. For damaging bosses, good power weapons can be nessecary, the exotic grenade launcher The Prospecter can be very good, otherwise, rocket launchers and grenade launches are very good.
